input: Apply for a sabbatical leave from work

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Sabbatical Leave From Work
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a sabbatical leave from their current employer.

questions.title: How long do you want the sabbatical to be?
questions.description: Understand the intended duration of the sabbatical leave (e.g., 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year).

questions.title: When do you plan to start the sabbatical?
questions.description: Identify the target start date or timeframe the user has in mind for beginning their leave.

questions.title: What is the primary purpose of your sabbatical?
questions.description: Clarify the main reason for requesting leave, such as research, travel, personal development, family, or a creative project.

questions.title: Does your employer have a formal sabbatical policy?
questions.description: Determine whether the user's company has an existing sabbatical program with defined eligibility criteria and procedures.

questions.title: Who do you need to submit the request to?
questions.description: Identify the decision-maker or department the application must go through, such as a direct manager, HR, or an executive.

questions.title: Do you need the sabbatical to be paid or unpaid?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user requires salary continuation, partial pay, or is prepared to take unpaid leave.

questions.title: What is your current tenure at the company?
questions.description: Establish how long the user has been employed, as eligibility for sabbatical is often tied to years of service.
